Game Overview

At its heart, Lion Prince is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Lion Prince follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Lion Prince?

Lion Prince is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Lion Prince free to play?

Yes, Lion Prince is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
